  "permission": {
    "edit": "ask",
    "bash": {
      // Allow read-only operations
      "git status": "allow",
      "git diff": "allow",
      "git diff *": "allow",
      "git log": "allow",
      "git log *": "allow",
      "pnpm -w check": "allow",
      "pnpm --filter * check": "allow",
      "pnpm -F * check": "allow",
      "curl -s *": "allow",
      "ls": "allow",
      "ls *": "allow",
      "pwd": "allow",
      "cat *": "allow",
      
      // Ask for approval on destructive operations
      "git push": "ask",
      "git push *": "ask",
      "git commit": "ask",
      "git commit *": "ask",
      "rm *": "ask",
      "npm install": "ask",
      "npm install *": "ask",
      "pnpm install": "ask",
      "pnpm install *": "ask",
      
      // Deny dangerous operations
      "terraform *": "deny",
      "kubectl delete *": "deny",
      
      // Allow everything else
      "*": "allow"
    }
  },
input.newString:
// Permissions - ask before destructive operations
  "permission": {
    "edit": "ask",
    "bash": {
      // Git operations (read-only)
      "git status": "allow",
      "git diff *": "allow",
      "git log *": "allow",
      "git show *": "allow",
      
      // Quality checks
      "pnpm -w check": "allow",
      "pnpm -w lint": "allow",
      "pnpm -w lint:fix": "allow",
      "pnpm -w format": "allow",
      "pnpm --filter * check": "allow",
      "pnpm --filter * lint": "allow",
      "pnpm -F * check": "allow",
      "biome format *": "allow",
      "biome check *": "allow",
      
      // Type generation
      "pnpm --filter @myproject/frontend generate:types": "allow",
      
      // Package info (read-only)
      "pnpm list *": "allow",
      "pnpm why *": "allow",
      "pnpm view *": "allow",
      "pnpm outdated *": "allow",
      "pnpm dlx *": "allow",
      "npm view *": "allow",
      "npm search *": "allow",
      
      // Database queries (read-only)
      "psql *": "allow",
      
      // Build
      "pnpm build": "allow",
      
      // Utilities
      "ls *": "allow",
      "cat *": "allow",
      "curl *": "allow",
      "grep *": "allow",
      "find *": "allow",
      "tree *": "allow",
      "jq *": "allow",
      "pwd": "allow",
      "echo *": "allow",
      "npx shadcn@latest view *": "allow",
      
      // Ask for approval on destructive operations
      "git push *": "ask",
      "git commit *": "ask",
      "git clone *": "ask",
      "pnpm install *": "ask",
      "pnpm add *": "ask",
      "pnpm remove *": "ask",
      "npm install *": "ask",
      "pnpm --filter * db:generate": "ask",
      "pnpm --filter * db:migrate": "ask",
      "rm *": "ask",
      "docker *": "ask",
      
      // Allow everything else by default
      "*": "allow"
    }
  },
